<thought>We need to find a retrosynthetic template that matches the carbonyl‑ene transformation described. Using the valid functional group names from the catalog, we will search for templates that break a ketone and a C‑C double bond, and form an aliphatic hydroxyl and a five‑membered ring, with C‑C and C‑O bonds formed. This should return one or more template IDs that we can then apply to the target molecule to obtain all possible precursor combinations.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "[CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)[C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18]",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "C-C double bonds"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["aliphatic hydroxyls", "five-membered rings"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-C", "C-O"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C=C", "C=O"],
    "bonds_order_changed": ["C=C (2.0->1.0)", "C=O (2.0->1.0)"],
    "limit": 5
}
